Method of Attack: Credential stealing by hooking into Windows LSASS API functions to capture domain names, usernames, and passwords
Deploying web shells on compromised servers to gain and maintain access
Open-source backdoor used to maintain access
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2021-40539 vulnerability in Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus allowing remote code execution without authentication
Indicators of Compromise: Compromise of at least nine organizations worldwide in defense, healthcare, energy, technology, and education sectors
At least 370 Zoho ManageEngine servers targeted in the United States
Use of Godzilla web shells and NGLite backdoor
Harvesting of Active Directory database file (ntds.dit) and SYSTEM hive from registry
